## dl-02a-face-metric-learning

**DLCV 02A · Face Recognition and Metric Learning** · DLCV 02A・臉部辨識與度量學習  
How deep networks recognize people they never saw in training: verification and identification in closed and open sets, detection and landmark alignment, normalized embeddings, contrastive and triplet losses, margin-based softmax losses (SphereFace, CosFace, ArcFace), TAR at a fixed FAR, ROC and DET curves, CMC and FPIR, datasets and their withdrawal, demographic differentials, privacy and presentation attacks.

## dl-06b-video-understanding

**DLCV 08 · Video Understanding and Action Recognition** · DLCV 08・影片理解與動作辨識  
How deep networks recognize what happens in a video: the tasks (clip classification, temporal and spatio-temporal action localization, retrieval and question answering), why time is hard to learn, two-stream, 3D, (2+1)D, SlowFast, TSN/TSM and video-transformer architectures, masked video pretraining, evaluation protocols, datasets and failure modes such as scene bias.

## dl-04b-video-super-resolution

## dl-08a-depth-optical-flow

**DLCV 11A · Depth Estimation and Optical Flow** · DLCV 11A・深度估計與光流  
Dense correspondence for depth and motion: rectified stereo and disparity, matching costs, semi-global matching and learned cost volumes, monocular relative and metric depth with scale-and-shift-invariant losses, self-supervised depth from video, optical flow from FlowNet to RAFT, scene flow, and the metrics, benchmarks and failure modes of all three, with tested NumPy and OpenCV code.

## dl-11-robustness

**DLCV 14 · Robustness: Distribution Shift, Adversarial Examples and Anomalies** · DLCV 14・穩健性：分布偏移、對抗樣本與異常
